verses.sloka: मन्थरा त्वभ्यसूयैनामुत्सृज्याभरणं च तत्।उवाचेदं ततो वाक्यं कोपदुःखसमन्विता ॥२-८-१॥
verses.transliteration: mantharā tvabhyasūyaināmutsṛjyābharaṇaṁ ca tat।uvācedaṁ tato vākyaṁ kopaduḥkhasamanvitā ॥2-8-1॥

translations.english: Annoyed with Kaikeyi and filled with rage and sorrow, Manthara discarded the ornament (gifted to her) and said these words:
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार महाराज द्वारा मनायी जाने पर कैकेयी कुछ-कुछ शान्त हुई, किन्तु महाराज को पीड़ित करने के लिए उनसे अति दुःखदायी अप्रिय बचन कहने लगा ॥४०] अयोध्याकाण्ड का दसवाँ सर्ग समाप्त हुआ । ` एकादशः सगः तं मन्मथशरे्िद्धं कामवेगवशालुगम्‌ । . उवाच पृथिवीपालं कैकेयी दारुणं वचः

verses.sloka: हर्षं किमिदमस्थाने कृतवत्यसि बालिशे ।शोकसागरमध्यस्थमात्मानं नावबुध्यसे ॥२-८-२॥
verses.transliteration: harṣaṁ kimidamasthāne kṛtavatyasi bāliśe ।śokasāgaramadhyasthamātmānaṁ nāvabudhyase ॥2-8-2॥

translations.english: O foolish woman why do you display this misplaced happiness, little realising that you are in the midst of an ocean of sorrow?

verses.sloka: मनसा प्रहसामि त्वां देवि दुःखार्धिता सती ।यच्छोचितव्ये हृष्टासि प्राप्येदं व्यसनं महत् ॥२-८-३॥
verses.transliteration: manasā prahasāmi tvāṁ devi duḥkhārdhitā satī ।yacchocitavye hṛṣṭāsi prāpyedaṁ vyasanaṁ mahat ॥2-8-3॥

translations.english: O queen at a time when this great misfortune has befallen you, you are rejoicing instead of feeling miserable. I am indeed laughing at you at heart.
translations.hindi: मुझे न तो कोई बीमारी है और न किसी ने मेरा अपमान ही _ | र (या है। किन्तु मेरी एक इच्छा बे जिसे आप पूरी कर सकते... | NAN अथवा मेरा एक काम दै, जिसे मैं तुमसे करवाना चाहती ॥ र न SS a $ र त्र्‌ , र > हि क ही ट 332 $ < २3 “SP A क 20 0० 5 नी ता--रेगग्रस्ता। ( गो० ) न्स 2०200 0000 करार रारा हिन एक प्रतिज्ञा प्रतिजानीष्व यदि त्वं कतुमिच्छसि । अथ तद्च्याहरिष्यामि यदभिप्रार्थितं मया

verses.sloka: शोचामि दुर्मतित्वं ते का हि प्राज्ञा प्रहर्षयेत् ।अरेः सपत्नीपुत्रस्य वृद्धिं मृत्युमिवागताम् ॥२-८-४॥
verses.transliteration: śocāmi durmatitvaṁ te kā hi prājñā praharṣayet ।areḥ sapatnīputrasya vṛddhiṁ mṛtyumivāgatām ॥2-8-4॥

translations.english: I pity your false notion. Will any wise woman rejoice at the prosperity of the son of a cowife who is like an enemy? This is like (courting) death.
translations.hindi: ताम्‌ कैकेयी का यह वचन सुन, काम से व्याकुल महाराज दशरथ, जमीन पर पड़ी हुई कैकेयी का सिर हाथों से उठा अपनी गोद में रख, मुसक्या कर बोले

verses.sloka: भरतादेव रामस्य राज्यसाधारणाद्भयम् ।तद्विचिन्त्य विषण्णास्मि भय भीताद्धि जायते ॥२-८-५॥
verses.transliteration: bharatādeva rāmasya rājyasādhāraṇādbhayam ।tadvicintya viṣaṇṇāsmi bhaya bhītāddhi jāyate ॥2-8-5॥

translations.english: Since Bharata and Rama have equal claim to the kingdom, Bharata is a source of fear for Rama. Having thought over this matter, I am dejected. Danger springs from one who is in fear.

verses.sloka: लक्ष्मणो हि महेष्वासो रामं सर्वात्मना गतः ।शत्रुघ्नश्चापि भरतं काकुत्थ्सं लक्ष्मणो यथा ॥२-८-६॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣmaṇo hi maheṣvāso rāmaṁ sarvātmanā gataḥ ।śatrughnaścāpi bharataṁ kākutthsaṁ lakṣmaṇo yathā ॥2-8-6॥

translations.english: Lakshmana who wields a great bow has taken refuge with all his heart in Rama a descendant of Kakutstha dynasty. So does Satrughna in Bharata.
translations.hindi: सो तुमसे भी अधिक प्रिय, शत्रुओं से अजेय और सब से मुख्य श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की शपथ खा कर, हम कहते हैं कि, जो तू - चाहती हो सो कह

verses.sloka: प्रत्यासन्नक्रमेणापि भरतस्तैव भामिनि ।राज्यक्रमो विप्रकृष्टस्तयोस्तावत्कनीयसोः ॥२-८-७॥
verses.transliteration: pratyāsannakrameṇāpi bharatastaiva bhāmini ।rājyakramo viprakṛṣṭastayostāvatkanīyasoḥ ॥2-8-7॥

translations.english: O beautiful lady in order of birth, too, Bharata's right to the throne is just next (to Rama's). While being younger, the chances of the other two (Lakshmana and Satrughna) are remote.
translations.hindi: अवलिप्ते-सौमाग्यगर्विते | ( गो० ) बा० रा० अ०-८ हे. केकेयी: ! जिन -श्रीरामचन्द्र को देखे बिना. एक: घड़ी भी जीना हमारे लिए असम्भव है, उन्हीं की शपथ खा कर हम कहते हैं कि तेरा काम हम कर गे

verses.sloka: विदुषः क्षत्रचारित्रे प्राज्ञस्य प्राप्तकारिणः ।भयात्प्रवेपे रामस्य चिन्तयन्ती तवात्मजम् ॥२-८-८॥
verses.transliteration: viduṣaḥ kṣatracāritre prājñasya prāptakāriṇaḥ ।bhayātpravepe rāmasya cintayantī tavātmajam ॥2-8-8॥

translations.english: Rama is learned in the duties of a kshatriya. He is wise enough to do what he should at the appropriate time. While reflecting the fate of your son, I am trembling with fear.
translations.hindi: हम अपने से ओर अन्य तीनों पुत्रां से जिन श्रीरामचन्द्र को अधिक मानते र्‍या चाहते हैं अथवा अपना शरीर ब अन्य तीनों पुत्रों को दे डाल कर भोजिन श्रीरामचन्द्र को रखना चाहते हैं तेरा बचन पूरा करने को उन्हींकी हम शपथ खाते हैं

verses.sloka: सुभगा खलु कौसल्या यस्याः पुत्रोऽभिषेक्ष्यते ।यौवराज्येन महता श्वः पुष्येण द्विजोत्तमैः ॥२-८-९॥
verses.transliteration: subhagā khalu kausalyā yasyāḥ putro'bhiṣekṣyate ।yauvarājyena mahatā śvaḥ puṣyeṇa dvijottamaiḥ ॥2-8-9॥

translations.english: Kausalya whose son is going to be coronated as heirapparent by eminent brahmins under Pushya star tomorrow is fortunate, indeed.

verses.sloka: प्राप्तां सुमहतीं प्रीतिं प्रतीतां तां हतद्विषम् ।उपस्थास्यसि कौसल्यां दासीवत्त्वं कृताञ्जलिः ॥२-८-१०॥
verses.transliteration: prāptāṁ sumahatīṁ prītiṁ pratītāṁ tāṁ hatadviṣam ।upasthāsyasi kausalyāṁ dāsīvattvaṁ kṛtāñjaliḥ ॥2-8-10॥

translations.english: With folded palms like an attendant, you will have to serve that renowned Kausalya who is greatlly delighted by getting rid of her enemies.

verses.sloka: एवम् चेत्त्वं सहास्माभिस्तस्याः प्रेष्य भविष्यसि ।पुत्रश्च तव रामस्य प्रेष्यभावं गमिष्यति ॥२-८-११॥
verses.transliteration: evam cettvaṁ sahāsmābhistasyāḥ preṣya bhaviṣyasi ।putraśca tava rāmasya preṣyabhāvaṁ gamiṣyati ॥2-8-11॥

translations.english: If you thus become her attendant along with us, your son will also develop slavishness towards Rama.
translations.hindi: हमारी तेरे ऊपर जैसी प्रीति है उसको विचार कर 'किसी बात की शङ्का मत कर । हम अपने पुण्यों की शपथ खा, कर कहते हैं कि, . त्‌ जो कहेगी वहीम्हम "करगे ॥१० ` -`` = | १ वृणे-श्रसमम्जाने।“(रा०“) २ अनुमश्य--+विचाय-|८( रा० ) ॐ ३साघु-इष्टं। (गो०) : `` ss Ne फक, i ®" gt h ET STC CETTE SES ५-७ ५ कोक मै SER ERASER inn to न जु 0 सा तदथेमना देवी तमभिप्रायमागतम्‌'। निमांध्यस्थ्यात्महषांच बभाषे दुर्वचं वच:

verses.sloka: हृष्टाः खलु भविष्यन्ति रामस्य परमाः स्त्रियः ।अप्रहृष्टा भविष्यन्ति स्नुषास्ते भरतक्षये ॥२-८-१२॥
verses.transliteration: hṛṣṭāḥ khalu bhaviṣyanti rāmasya paramāḥ striyaḥ ।aprahṛṣṭā bhaviṣyanti snuṣāste bharatakṣaye ॥2-8-12॥

translations.english: All the women of Rama's (palace) will be delighted indeed. With the decline of Bharata, your daughtersinlaw will be deprived of all happiness.
translations.hindi: महाराज की बातों से अत्यन्त प्रसन्न हो और अपना मतलब पूरा, करने को आए हुए महाभयङ्कर यमराज की तरह केकेयी . बोली

verses.sloka: तां दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतां ब्रुवन्तीं मन्थरां ततः ।रामस्यैव गुणान् देवी कैकेयि प्रशशंस ह ॥२-८-१३॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ dṛṣṭvā paramaprītāṁ bruvantīṁ mantharāṁ tataḥ ।rāmasyaiva guṇān devī kaikeyi praśaśaṁsa ha ॥2-8-13॥

translations.english: Having seen that morose Manthara speaking thus, Kaikeyi commended the virtues of Rama.
translations.hindi: हे महाराज | आफ मुके वर देने की शपथ. खा चुके हैं, इस बात: क्रे:साक्षी -अग्नि प्रमुख ३३ देवता रहें । ( अथोत्‌ इस कथन से कैकेयी पति को अपनी प्रतिज्ञा पर अटल रहने के लिए दृढ़ करती ज़्है ।)

verses.sloka: धर्मज्ञो गुरुभिर्दान्तः कृतज्ञ सत्यवाक्चुचि ।रामो राज्ञः सुतो ज्येष्ठो यौवराज्यमतोऽर्हति ॥२-८-१४॥
verses.transliteration: dharmajño gurubhirdāntaḥ kṛtajña satyavākcuci ।rāmo rājñaḥ suto jyeṣṭho yauvarājyamato'rhati ॥2-8-14॥

translations.english: Rama knows righteouness. He has been taught selfrestraint by elders. He is grateful and truthful. He is undefiled. He is the eldest son of the king. Therefore, he deserves to be the heirapparent (of the kingdom).
translations.hindi: उहेल्महाराज"!* चन्ट्रमा, ' सूर्य; आकाशा, -अह, ` रात, दिन ओर !दिशाएँ) जगत्‌, सब लोकों के निवासी, पृथ्वी, गन्धं, राक्षस, भूत, गृहदेवता और और भी जो प्राणी हैं, वे सब आपके रहे

verses.sloka: भ्रात्R^ऊन्भऋत्यांश्च दीर्घायुः पितृवत्पालयिष्यति ।संतप्यसे कथं कुब्जे श्रुत्वा रामाभिषेचनम् ॥२-८-१५॥
verses.transliteration: bhrātR^ūnbhaṛtyāṁśca dīrghāyuḥ pitṛvatpālayiṣyati ।saṁtapyase kathaṁ kubje śrutvā rāmābhiṣecanam ॥2-8-15॥

translations.english: Blessed with a long life, Rama will protect his brothers and the servants like a father. O hunchback, hearing Rama's coronation why are you aggrieved?

verses.sloka: भरतश्चापि रामस्य ध्रुवं वर्षशतात्परम् ।पितृपैतामहं राज्यमवाप्ता पुरुषर्षभः ॥२-८-१६॥
verses.transliteration: bharataścāpi rāmasya dhruvaṁ varṣaśatātparam ।pitṛpaitāmahaṁ rājyamavāptā puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥2-8-16॥

translations.english: After a hundred years of Rama's rule, Bharata, the best of men, will get the kingdom of his ancestors.
translations.hindi: सत्यसन्ध, महातेजस्वी, धर्मज्ञ, सदेव सावधान रहने बाले महाराज हमको बर देते हैं यह बात सब देवता सुनें

verses.sloka: सा त्वमभ्युदये प्राप्ते वर्तमाने च मन्थरे ।भविष्यति च क्ल्याणे किमर्थं परितप्यसे ॥२-८-१७॥
verses.transliteration: sā tvamabhyudaye prāpte vartamāne ca manthare ।bhaviṣyati ca klyāṇe kimarthaṁ paritapyase ॥2-8-17॥

translations.english: Manthara, we have enjoyed prosperity in the past, we are enjoying it now and we will enjoy it in future. Then why are you aggrieved?
translations.hindi: राजमहिषी कैकेयी ने महाधनुधीरी, वर देने को उद्यत और कामातुर महाराज' को वचनबद्ध कर और उनकी प्रशंसा कर कहा

verses.sloka: यथा ने भरतो मान्यस्तथा भूयोऽपि राघावः ।कौसल्यातोऽरिक्तं च सो हि शुश्रूषते हि माम् ॥२-८-१८॥
verses.transliteration: yathā ne bharato mānyastathā bhūyo'pi rāghāvaḥ ।kausalyāto'riktaṁ ca so hi śuśrūṣate hi mām ॥2-8-18॥

translations.english: For me, if Bharata is worthy of consideration Rama is worthier. He serves me even more (scrupulously) than he does Kausalya.

verses.sloka: राज्यं यदि हि रामस्य भरतस्यापि तत्तदा ।मन्यते हि यथात्मानं तथा भ्रात्R^ऊंश्च राघवः ॥२-८-१९॥
verses.transliteration: rājyaṁ yadi hi rāmasya bharatasyāpi tattadā ।manyate hi yathātmānaṁ tathā bhrātR^ūṁśca rāghavaḥ ॥2-8-19॥

translations.english: If the kingdom is Rama's, it is also Bharata's, since Rama regards his brothers as his own self

verses.sloka: कैकेयीवचनं श्रुत्वा मन्थरा भृशदुःखिता ।दीर्घमुष्णं निःश्वस्य कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-८-२०॥
verses.transliteration: kaikeyīvacanaṁ śrutvā mantharā bhṛśaduḥkhitā ।dīrghamuṣṇaṁ niḥśvasya kaikeyīmidamabravīt ॥2-8-20॥

translations.english: Having heard Kaikeyi's words Manthara was extremely unhappy. Heaving deep, hot sighs she said to Kaikeyi.

verses.sloka: अनर्थदर्शिनी मौर्ख्यान्नात्मानमवबुध्यसे ।शोकव्यसनविस्तीर्णे मज्जन्ती दुःखसागरे ॥२-८-२१॥
verses.transliteration: anarthadarśinī maurkhyānnātmānamavabudhyase ।śokavyasanavistīrṇe majjantī duḥkhasāgare ॥2-8-21॥

translations.english: You are sinking in the sea of sorrow widened with tears and troubles. But you are stupid enough not to perceive your own wellbeing.
translations.hindi: और यदि धर्मानुसार प्रतिज्ञा करके तुम वे दोनों वर मुके !इस समय न दोगे तो अपने इस अपमान के कारण तुम्हारे सामने में सर जाऊंगी

verses.sloka: भविता राघवो राजा राघवस्यानु यः सुतः ।राजवंशात्तु कैकेयि भरतः परिहास्यते ॥२-८-२२॥
verses.transliteration: bhavitā rāghavo rājā rāghavasyānu yaḥ sutaḥ ।rājavaṁśāttu kaikeyi bharataḥ parihāsyate ॥2-8-22॥

translations.english: Rama, the scion of the Raghus, will become king. After Rama, his son will suceed him. O Kaikeyi, as for Bharata, he will be debarred from royal succession (altogether).
translations.hindi: महाराज दशरथ को कैकेयी ने केबल वाणी से अपने बश में उसी तरह कर लिया, जिस तरह (बहेलिया) हिरन को मारने के लिए जाल में बाँध लेता है

verses.sloka: न हि राज्ञः सुताः सर्वे राज्ये तिष्ठन्ति भामिनि ।स्थाप्यमानेषु सर्वेषु सुमहाननयो भवेत् ॥२-८-२३॥
verses.transliteration: na hi rājñaḥ sutāḥ sarve rājye tiṣṭhanti bhāmini ।sthāpyamāneṣu sarveṣu sumahānanayo bhavet ॥2-8-23॥

translations.english: O lovely lady, not all the sons of the king will inherit the kingdom. If all of them are installed as kings, there will be great disorder.

verses.sloka: तस्माज्ज्येष्ठे हि कैकेयि राज्यतन्त्राणि पार्थिवाः ।स्थापयन्त्यनवद्याङ्गि गुणवत्स्वतरेष्वपि ॥२-८-२४॥
verses.transliteration: tasmājjyeṣṭhe hi kaikeyi rājyatantrāṇi pārthivāḥ ।sthāpayantyanavadyāṅgi guṇavatsvatareṣvapi ॥2-8-24॥

translations.english: O Kaikeyi of beautiful limbs, for that reason kings bestow the governance of the kingdom either on the eldest or on other virtuous sons.

verses.sloka: असावत्यन्तनिर्भग्न स्तवपुत्रो भविष्यति ।अनाथवत्सुखेभ्यश्च राजवंशाच्च वत्सले ॥२-८-२५॥
verses.transliteration: asāvatyantanirbhagna stavaputro bhaviṣyati ।anāthavatsukhebhyaśca rājavaṁśācca vatsale ॥2-8-25॥

translations.english: O (Kaikeyi) dear cut off from royal succession as well as from its comforts, your son will become totally forlorn and brokenhearted.
translations.hindi: उन दोनों को मैं अभी माँगती हूँ । सुनो रामचन्द्र के अभिषेक लिए जो सामान सँजोया गया है

verses.sloka: साहं त्वदर्थे संप्राप्ता त्वं तु मां नावबुध्यसे ।सपत्निवृद्दौ या मे त्वं प्रदेयं दातुमिच्चिसि ॥२-८-२६॥
verses.transliteration: sāhaṁ tvadarthe saṁprāptā tvaṁ tu māṁ nāvabudhyase ।sapatnivṛddau yā me tvaṁ pradeyaṁ dātumiccisi ॥2-8-26॥

translations.english: I am here to serve your interest. Nevertheless you do not understand me and you wish to confer gifts on me on the occasion of the prosperity of your cowife.

verses.sloka: ध्रुवं तु भरतं रामः प्राप्य राज्यमकण्टकम् ।देशान्तरं वासयिता लोकान्तरमथापि व ॥२-८-२७॥
verses.transliteration: dhruvaṁ tu bharataṁ rāmaḥ prāpya rājyamakaṇṭakam ।deśāntaraṁ vāsayitā lokāntaramathāpi va ॥2-8-27॥

translations.english: Rama, having secured the thornless kingdom, will banish Bharata from the country or else send him to the other world. This is certain.

verses.sloka: बाल एव हि मातुल्यं भरतो नायितस्त्वया ।सन्निकर्षाच्च सौहार्दं जायते स्थावरेष्वपि ॥२-८-२८॥
verses.transliteration: bāla eva hi mātulyaṁ bharato nāyitastvayā ।sannikarṣācca sauhārdaṁ jāyate sthāvareṣvapi ॥2-8-28॥

translations.english: Bharata has been sent by you right from his childhood to his maternal uncle's house. Proximity creates friendship even amongst the inanimate objects.

verses.sloka: भरतस्यानुवशगः शत्रुघ्नोऽपि समं गतः ।लक्ष्मणो हि यथा रामं तथासौ भरतं गतः ॥२-८-२९॥
verses.transliteration: bharatasyānuvaśagaḥ śatrughno'pi samaṁ gataḥ ।lakṣmaṇo hi yathā rāmaṁ tathāsau bharataṁ gataḥ ॥2-8-29॥

translations.english: Satrughna who is obedient to Bharata has followed him. Like Lakshmana who has taken refuge in Rama, he has also resorted to Bharata.
translations.hindi: एष मे परम) कामो दत्तमेव वरं इणे] ` मुझे जो दो बर उस समय दिए: _ रॉमचन्द्र जटा-वल्कलं'घोरेण कर तापस वेष में रहें । मेरे पक्र: [Ss ON RR TS ७. अश्च हिभ्पॅश्येयंःपरथास्त' रॉधवःवभम्‌।। शटा | न बस, यही' मेरी परम कामना है। आपके दिए हुए ही वर मैं माँगती हूँ । में राम का बनगमनः आज ही देखना चाहती हूँ ॥र८॥ सं राजराजो भव सत्यसङ्गरः कुलं च शीलं च हि रक्ष जन्म च] परत्र वासे हि वदन्त्यनुत्तमं तपोधनाः सत्यवचो हितं त्रणाम्‌

verses.sloka: श्रूयते हि द्रुमः कश्चिच्चेत्तव्यो वनजीविभिः ।सन्निकर्षादिषीकाभिर्मो चितः परमाद्भयात् ॥२-८-३०॥
verses.transliteration: śrūyate hi drumaḥ kaściccettavyo vanajīvibhiḥ ।sannikarṣādiṣīkābhirmo citaḥ paramādbhayāt ॥2-8-30॥

translations.english: It is said that a tree intended to be cut down by those living on the forest is let off due to entanglement of a kind of grass known as Ishika (thorny bushes) growing in its vicinity. (If Bharata had been at Ayodhya now, Dasaratha himself would have helped him.

verses.sloka: गोप्ता हि रामं सौमित्रिर्लक्ष्मणं चापि राघवः ।अश्विनोरिव सौभ्रात्रं तयोर्लोकेषु विश्रुतम् ॥२-८-३१॥
verses.transliteration: goptā hi rāmaṁ saumitrirlakṣmaṇaṁ cāpi rāghavaḥ ।aśvinoriva saubhrātraṁ tayorlokeṣu viśrutam ॥2-8-31॥

translations.english: Just as Lakshmana protects Rama, Rama protects Lakshmana. Their brotherhood is renowned in the world like that of the Ashwins.

verses.sloka: तस्मान्न लक्ष्मणे रामः पापं किञ्चित्करिष्यति ।रामस्तु भरते पापं कुर्यादिति न सं शयः ॥२-८-३२॥
verses.transliteration: tasmānna lakṣmaṇe rāmaḥ pāpaṁ kiñcitkariṣyati ।rāmastu bharate pāpaṁ kuryāditi na saṁ śayaḥ ॥2-8-32॥

translations.english: Rama will do no harm to Lakshmana. As for Bharata, Rama will doubtless do him harm.

verses.sloka: तस्माद्राजगृहादेव वनं गच्छतु ते सुतः ।एतद्धि रोचते मह्यं भृशं चापि हितं तव ॥२-८-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tasmādrājagṛhādeva vanaṁ gacchatu te sutaḥ ।etaddhi rocate mahyaṁ bhṛśaṁ cāpi hitaṁ tava ॥2-8-33॥

translations.english: Therefore let your son go to the forest straight from his uncle's palace only. That alone will please me. For you also this is highly beneficial.

verses.sloka: एवं ते ज्ञातिपक्षस्य श्रेयश्चैव भविष्यति ।यदि चेद्भरतो धर्मात्पित्र्यं राज्यमवाप्स्यति ॥२-८-३४॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ te jñātipakṣasya śreyaścaiva bhaviṣyati ।yadi cedbharato dharmātpitryaṁ rājyamavāpsyati ॥2-8-34॥

translations.english: If Bharata secures the ancestral kingdom righteously, it will bring welfare to you and to your relations also.

verses.sloka: स ते सुखोचितो बालो रामस्य सहजो रिपुः ।समृद्धार्थस्य नष्टार्थो जीविष्यति कथं वशे ॥२-८-३५॥
verses.transliteration: sa te sukhocito bālo rāmasya sahajo ripuḥ ।samṛddhārthasya naṣṭārtho jīviṣyati kathaṁ vaśe ॥2-8-35॥

translations.english: Your son, that young Bharata, is accustomed to comforts. He is a born enemy of Rama. How will he, deprived of all wealth, live under the control of Rama?

verses.sloka: अभिद्रुतमिवारण्ये सिंहेन गजयूथपम् ।प्रच्छाद्यमानं रामेण भरतं त्रातुमर्हसि ॥२-८-३६॥
verses.transliteration: abhidrutamivāraṇye siṁhena gajayūthapam ।pracchādyamānaṁ rāmeṇa bharataṁ trātumarhasi ॥2-8-36॥

translations.english: Like the leader of an elephantherd attacked by a lion in the forest, Bharata is going to be oppressed by Rama. You should save him.

verses.sloka: दर्पान्निराकृता पूर्वं त्वया सौभाग्यवत्तया ।राममाता सपत्नी ते कथं वैरं न शातयेत् ॥२-८-३७॥
verses.transliteration: darpānnirākṛtā pūrvaṁ tvayā saubhāgyavattayā ।rāmamātā sapatnī te kathaṁ vairaṁ na śātayet ॥2-8-37॥

translations.english: Being fortunate (being the favourite wife of your husband) you slighted your cowife earlier with pride. How will she, Rama's mother (Kausalya) remain without retaliating?

verses.sloka: यदा हि रामः पृथिवीमवाप्स्यति ।प्रभूतरत्नाकरशैलपत्तनाम् ।तदा गमिष्यस्यशुभं पराभवं ।सहैव दीना भरतेन भामिनि ॥२-८-३८॥
verses.transliteration: yadā hi rāmaḥ pṛthivīmavāpsyati ।prabhūtaratnākaraśailapattanām ।tadā gamiṣyasyaśubhaṁ parābhavaṁ ।sahaiva dīnā bharatena bhāmini ॥2-8-38॥

translations.english: O lovely lady when Rama becomes the lord of this earth with its oceans, mountains and cities, then along with Bharata you will become miserable and fall into disgrace.

verses.sloka: यदा हि रामः पृथिवीमवाप्स्यति ।ध्रुवं प्रणष्टो भरतो भविष्यति ।अतो हि संचिन्तय राज्यमात्मजे ।पर्स्य चैवाद्य विवासकारणम् ॥२-८-३९॥
verses.transliteration: yadā hi rāmaḥ pṛthivīmavāpsyati ।dhruvaṁ praṇaṣṭo bharato bhaviṣyati ।ato hi saṁcintaya rājyamātmaje ।parsya caivādya vivāsakāraṇam ॥2-8-39॥

translations.english: When Rama obtains this earth, Bharata will be certainly ruined. Therefore, right now think of the kingdom for your son and the means of banishment for your enemy, Rama. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eighth sarga of Ayodhyakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
